messages:
anita_pm: Proposing a surgical hotfix weekend (Fri evening -> Mon morning) to hammer the highest-risk post-launch items: 1) memory leak in session cleanup causing OOMs on Dedicated, 2) noisy telemetry alerting that masks legit incidents, 3) missing error-context in streaming traces. Goal: restore Dedicated stability and remove noisy alerts so SRE can triage real regressions.

rachel_prod: +1. Suggest we keep scope strict: only small patches + config changes that have unit tests and a clear rollback path. No refactors.

tom_eng: I can take the session cleanup leak. Quick repro: long-lived sessions + partial failure path leaves session cache entries. I have a 3-line fix and a unit test that forces gc on session close. PR target: Fri 10:00 UTC.

sofia_support: Customer signal: 3 dedicated customers reported repeated node restarts this week; one has an open severity-2. They want a patch asap and a test window. I can coordinate test slots during the canary.

max_sre: Deployment plan notes: for Dedicated we can't do global 5% canary. Recommend per-customer staged push: first non-prod tenant, then one low-impact customer, then affected customers. Metrics to watch: node_restarts, mem_rss, stream_disconnect_rate. Rollback if node_restarts > baseline + 1 or mem_rss trend up after promotion.

anita_pm: Agreed. Acceptance criteria: customer S2 closed or downgraded, node restarts back to baseline for 48h, alert noise reduced by >=70%. Owners: tom -> leak fix; rachel -> acceptance tests & changelog; max_sre -> rollout + runbook; sofia -> customer comms.

rachel_prod: I will assemble a small test harness (3 prompts) to reproduce stream disconnects and a smoke script to validate session cleanup. Also will add a one-line health-check that verifies session counts post-deploy.

max_sre: deploy-bot: schedule window Fri 2026-04-02 22:00 UTC -> Mon 2026-04-05 08:00 UTC. Per-customer staged promotion starting 22:30 UTC.

deploy-bot: rollout scheduled. Pre-promote checklist: ```
- run smoke.sh against non-prod tenant (pass)
- check mem_rss < baseline * 1.1 after 15m
- node_restarts == 0 for 30m
- streaming_disconnect_rate <= baseline * 1.2
- verify logs contain session_cleanup:ok entries
```

sofia_support: I'll gather customer preferred slots and send invites for the 22:30 canary window. Also will prepare canned responses and the rollback notice.

tom_eng: FYI patch notes: session cache now uses weak refs + explicit finalizer on close. Added unit + integration test. If the fix reduces request throughput slightly we can toggle a perf flag. I'll open follow-up ticket for batching threshold re-tune.

rachel_prod: Rollback criterion: any sustained mem_rss increase >10% over baseline OR spike in stream_disconnect_rate > 30% for 15m. If triggered, promote previous build and notify customers.

max_sre: I will create ephemeral dashboards and an abbreviated runbook. Oncall will watch the runbook channel. I'll post links in here once ready.

anita_pm: Thanks. Once deploy-bot completes canary and you confirm metrics, we either promote or rollback. Keep updates concise in this thread please. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: Canary start event will post to this thread at 2026-04-02T22:30:00Z. Notifying oncall and owners.

sofia_support: Customers notified. Two asked for a dedicated test connection; I'll coordinate with max_sre.

tom_eng: Will post PR link and perf numbers before the window.

rachel_prod: I'll run the harness right after canary and post results.

anita_pm: If all green, we'll merge and schedule backfill tasks for next sprint (docs + postmortem). Success criteria reminder: S2 downgraded and alerts quiet for 48h.
